faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the BITS Pilani Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Junior Research Fellow position at BITS Pilani is 12th September 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post Graduate Degree in Basic Science or a Graduate/Post Graduate Degree in Professional Course (Engineering and Technology). Additionally, they must have qualified in national-level eligibility tests like CSIR-UGC NET or GATE.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive by BITS Pilani.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Junior Research Fellow position will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 37,000, which includes 20% House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q5. How will candidates be selected for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves preliminary shortlisting based on submitted applications and telephonic conversations, followed by a final interview for the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates are required to apply online through the official BITS Pilani website. Ensure all details are correctly filled and submitted before the closing date.

faq.question: Q7. Does BITS Pilani offer any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify age limits or relaxation details. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification for any such information.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The Junior Research Fellow position at BITS Pilani is a contractual role. This means the appointment will be for a fixed tenure as per the project requirements.

faq.question: Q9. What are the desirable skills for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: Desirable skills include knowledge of microbial fermentation, basic molecular biology techniques (PCR, cloning, DNA sequencing, protein analysis, electrophoresis), enzyme kinetics, and chromatographic analysis.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply?
faq.answer: The official notification and the application link can be found in the "Important Links" section of this article. It is recommended to download and read the notification thoroughly before applying.
